description: This file defines a base class for reminder tests within an Orleans-based distributed system. It provides common utilities, test operations, and method implementations to verify reminder functionality, including starting, stopping, listing, and failure handling of reminders across multiple grains and clusters.

classes.name: ReminderTests_Base
classes.description: A base class for conducting reminder-related tests in Orleans. It sets up test clusters, utilities for managing reminders, and methods to verify reminder behavior and failure scenarios.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cleans up reminders by instructing a grain to erase the reminder table.

methods.name: Test_Reminders_Basic_StopByRef
methods.description: Tests starting and stopping reminders by reference, ensuring proper removal and re-creation.

methods.name: Test_Reminders_Basic_ListOps
methods.description: Verifies listing of multiple reminders, their registered names, and timing accuracy.

methods.name: Test_Reminders_1J_MultiGrainMultiReminders
methods.description: Tests concurrent reminder operations (start/stop) across multiple grains and cluster scaling.

methods.name: Test_Reminders_ReminderNotFound
methods.description: Checks behavior when requesting a non-existent reminder.

methods.name: PerGrainMultiReminderTestChurn
methods.description: Performs start/stop churn tests on a grain's multiple reminders.

methods.name: PerGrainFailureTest
methods.description: Simulates reminder failure on a grain and verifies recovery markers.

methods.name: PerGrainMultiReminderTest
methods.description: Runs comprehensive start/stop cycles and timing checks for multiple reminders on a grain.

methods.name: PerCopyGrainFailureTest
methods.description: Tests reminder failure and recovery on a copy-based grain interface.

methods.name: Time
methods.description: Returns current UTC time as formatted string.

methods.name: AssertIsInRange
methods.description: Asserts that a value falls within an expected range with detailed logging.

methods.name: ExecuteWithRetries
methods.description: Retries a given asynchronous operation with timeout and error handling.

methods.name: ExecuteWithRetriesStop
methods.description: Retries a singleton stop operation with error handling.

methods.name: HandleError
methods.description: Handles retryable exceptions, with logging and delay between retries.
